name: Environmental
_sourcing_note: GRI 300 series (emissions, energy, water, waste, biodiversity) + SASB Commercial Banks Standard (financed emissions / environmental risk in lending). Session 5 recall audit added ESG (framework-level, often the only ESG-section anchor in bank narratives), sustainability (same role), GRI (direct reference to the reporting framework), net zero (climate commitment). Session 5 follow-up (sentence sample classified by human): added narrow phrases 'sustainable development' / 'sustainable financing' instead of bare 'sustainable' (73% precision at bare level was too generic — 'sustainable growth' / 'sustainable revenue' are business language, not ESG), and 'nature-positive' / 'nature-related' (TNFD terminology) instead of bare 'nature' (only 33% precision at bare level — most hits are accounting 'nature of the X').

name: Social
_sourcing_note: GRI 400 series (labor, human rights, community) + SASB Financial Sector Standard material topics (financial inclusion, data security, fair lending). Session 5 recall audit added zakat (Islamic charitable giving - regionally material S disclosure), CSR (framework label), financial literacy (GRI FS16-adjacent capability building), accessibility (SASB access-to-finance / GRI 203), supply chain (GRI 308 / 414 supplier screening).

name: Governance
_sourcing_note: GRI 2 (general disclosures: governance) + GRI 205 (anti-corruption). ICOFR/ITGC folded in here as internal-control sub-terms rather than standalone categories -- they are audit constructs, not ESG constructs in their own right, but internal control quality is a legitimate Governance-pillar signal. Session 5 recall audit added fraud (GRI 205-3 adjacent - a disclosable control failure), remuneration committee (GRI 2-19/2-20), ESG committee (GRI 2-14, growing board-level E/S oversight structure), anti-money laundering (SASB FN-CB-510 anti-corruption + money laundering).
